subject: ddl: do some code cleanup in ddl package (#62015)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent with focus on DDL/add-index/metadata paths. Main behavioral refactor is consolidating `DiskFullOpt_AllowedOnAlmostFull` into `pkg/ddl/session/session_pool.go` (`Get()` sets, `Put()` clears) and removing duplicated per-call-site setting in `pkg/ddl/delete_range.go`, `pkg/ddl/job_scheduler.go`, `pkg/ddl/job_submitter.go`. Backfill changes are limited to removing test-only reorg var loader/failpoint plumbing (`pkg/ddl/backfilling.go`, `pkg/ddl/backfilling_txn_executor.go`), while runtime worker sizing still comes from `ReorgMeta.GetConcurrency()` (`pkg/meta/model/reorg.go`) and per-session reorg execution context init remains explicit (`initSessCtx` usage). Metadata change in `pkg/meta/model/job.go` is method renaming/clarified semantics for stored system vars without changing JSON field name. No plausible Blocker/High issues found in correctness, consistency, concurrency, compatibility, or DDL state-machine/metadata handling within this commit.
